verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so a month-end close checklist is a fair question for it. The evidence covers authentication, contacts, invoicing, payments, MCP, webhooks and tax submission, but nothing on a close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals or review sign-offs.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
